meta.defaultTitle: Piyade Clan | TSB – Roblox The Strongest Battlegrounds Clan

footer.description: The Strongest Battlegrounds community and clan management platform. Active 24/7 with secure Discord bot REST API synchronization.

home.pageTitle: Piyade Clan | TSB – Roblox The Strongest Battlegrounds Clan
home.heroSubtitle: An elite battle clan uniting camaraderie, competition, and unwavering discipline in the Roblox TSB universe. Prove your tier, rise in official VS matches, and claim victory with your clan.
home.featuresTitle: What Makes Piyade Clan | TSB Unstoppable
home.featuresSubtitle: Our Roblox and Discord infrastructure runs in real-time synchronization with our bot's REST API.
home.feat1Desc: A professional skill evaluation hierarchy spanning from Low weak 4 all the way to the pinnacle of High strong 0.
home.feat2Desc: Staff-supervised official clan matches held in dedicated 48-hour rooms with live leaderboard tracking.
home.feat3Desc: Call for clan reinforcements with one click when raided in-game. Our bot dispatches your Roblox link to online members.
home.feat4Desc: Automatic 30-day point amnesty rule, fair role hierarchy checks, and transparent penalty management.
home.manifestoLine3: Piyade Clan | TSB — Apex of TSB.
home.meteorsSubtitle: Click the sky to call one down.
home.discordCtaDesc: Stay connected for tournament announcements, active voice channels, and instant backup dispatches.

rules.pageTitle: Official Clan Rules & Code of Conduct | Piyade Clan | TSB
rules.heading: 📜 Piyade Clan | TSB General Rules
rules.subheading: The articles below are established to preserve peace, respectful competition, and fair administration across our server. All rules are served from a single central configuration (rules.js).
rules.searchPlaceholder: 🔍 Search by rule code or keyword (e.g., M1, respect, spam, jail)...
rules.amnestyDesc: Members who go 30 consecutive days without receiving a new penalty have their warning points and warning roles automatically cleared by the bot. Members reaching 15 points are placed in Suspended (Jail) status for 1 week.

register.heading: Clan Registration Application
register.subheading: Complete the steps below to join the Piyade Team community and receive your verified server member roles.
register.loginReqDesc: You need to sign in with Discord so your registration application can be directly linked to your Discord profile in our server.
register.approvedTitle: You Are a Verified Active Member!
register.approvedDesc: Your Discord and Roblox accounts have been verified and your clan member roles are active.
register.pendingTitle: Your Application Is Awaiting Staff Approval
register.pendingDesc: Your registration application has been received. An approval card and a private registration channel have been created on our Discord server. Our staff will review it shortly.
register.pendingNote: Your clan roles will be assigned automatically once approved.
register.rejectedHint: Please correct the missing or inaccurate information in the form below and submit again.
register.helpRealName: Your server nickname will be formatted as {Real Name} | {Roblox Nick}.
register.labelRoblox: Roblox Username, ID, or Profile URL
register.helpRoblox: Important: Enter your actual @username or numeric ID, not your Display Name. The system verifies account authenticity and ban status via the Roblox API.
register.errRealNameLength: Please enter a valid real name (between 2 and 32 characters).
register.errSelectGender: Please select a valid gender option.
register.errRobloxRequired: Please enter a valid Roblox username, ID, or profile URL.
register.msgSubmittedSuccess: Your registration application has been sent to the bot! A review card has been opened for staff.

profile.statKillsDesc: Total eliminations in official VS matches
profile.unregisteredMsg: Your registration details have not been recorded yet. Please complete the registration form.
profile.jailThresholdNote: Members reaching 15 points are automatically placed in quarantine (jail) for 1 week.
profile.staffWarnNote: All staff permissions are automatically revoked upon the 4th staff warning.
profile.amnestyBoxText: Automatic Amnesty: If you commit no rule violations for 30 consecutive days after your last penalty, all penalty points are automatically cleared.

tryout.heading: 🏆 Tryout Evaluation Leaderboard
tryout.subheading: Clan skill rankings spanning from Low weak 4 to the peak of High strong 0.
tryout.emptyDesc: Evaluations completed by staff on our Discord server will automatically appear in this leaderboard.
tryout.dartCardDesc: Warm up before your Tryout evaluation! Press and hold on the board to aim, release, and hit the Bullseye.

help.heading: 🚨 Emergency Backup / Reinforcement Call
help.subheading: Request immediate clan backup with a single click when your Roblox The Strongest Battlegrounds server is raided or you need urgent support.
help.statActiveDesc: Clan members currently online (Online, Idle, DND) in Discord
help.statCooldownDesc: Each member can dispatch an emergency backup call once every 5 minutes
help.callCardDesc: As soon as you press the button, our Discord bot posts an instant join card with your Roblox Profile link to the emergency channel and pings active clan members.
help.confirmCall: Are you sure you want to dispatch an emergency backup call? Active members in the server will be notified immediately.
help.infoItem1: The backup call is dispatched directly to the <#1559928245598560336> alert channel.
help.infoItem2: Your Roblox Profile Link is embedded in the alert card so clan members can join your game server in one click.
help.infoItem3: To prevent spam and false alarms, a 5-minute cooldown and disciplinary rules are strictly enforced.
help.msgCallSuccess: Your emergency backup call has been dispatched!

interactive.pageTitle: Dart Range & Meteor Sky — Piyade Clan | TSB
interactive.subheading: Physics-driven dart rating board, interactive canvas meteor shower sky, and smooth scroll-reveal typography crafted for Piyade Clan | TSB.
interactive.dartDesc: Press and hold on the board to charge power, release to throw!
interactive.dartTipText: Keys 1–9, 0 (Bullseye), and Arrow keys throw a perfect dart at that ring when focused or visible.
interactive.dartAriaLabel: Dart rating target slider. Hold and release to throw, or use arrow and number keys 1 to 10.
interactive.meteorsSectionDesc: Bend passing meteors toward your cursor, or click/tap anywhere on the sky to strike that spot in a ring of sparks!
interactive.manifestoHint: As you scroll up and down, the manifesto lines smoothly transition from blur into sharp focus.

adminMembers.heading: 👥 Member Information & Disciplinary Records
adminMembers.subheading: Search server members and inspect their Discord, Roblox, Tryout, VS, and disciplinary history in real time.
adminMembers.unregisteredMemberMsg: This user has not registered on the server yet.
adminMembers.emptyHistoryMsg: No past disciplinary warnings or penalties found for this member.
adminMembers.emptyFormsMsg: No tryout evaluation forms have been submitted for this user yet.
adminMembers.searchPlaceholder: 🔍 Search by name, Discord username, Roblox nick, or ID...
adminMembers.noMembersFoundTitle: No members found matching your criteria
adminMembers.noMembersFoundDesc: Please try again with a different Discord username, ID, or Roblox nickname.

adminWarn.heading: ⚠️ Issue Warning / Disciplinary Action
adminWarn.subheading: Apply Verbal or Official disciplinary actions to members who violate server rules. Both the web panel and Bot REST API enforce role hierarchy and sanction rules.
adminWarn.placeholderMemberSearch: Type name, Discord username, Roblox nick, or ID...
adminWarn.hierarchyNote: Hierarchy Protection: You cannot warn yourself or staff members with equal/higher roles than yours. Enforced on both site and bot.
adminWarn.placeholderReason: Enter detailed explanation regarding the violation...
adminWarn.reasonHelp: A reason is required for verbal warnings. For official warnings, it is appended to the rule description if provided.
adminWarn.labelEvidenceSection: 📎 Evidence Image (Optional — PNG, JPG, WEBP Only • Max 5 MB)
adminWarn.labelUploadFile: Upload File from Device (Forwarded Directly from Memory to Bot API)
adminWarn.evidenceHelp: Uploaded images are never saved to web server disk; they are validated in RAM and forwarded directly to the Bot API and Discord log channel.
adminWarn.loaderTimeoutErr: Request timed out. Please check your connection and try again.
adminWarn.loaderNetworkErr: A network error occurred while connecting to the server. Please try again.
adminWarn.confirmWarn: Are you sure you want to apply this disciplinary action? It will take effect on the Discord server immediately.
adminWarn.errSelectTarget: Please select a valid target member or enter a valid Discord ID.
adminWarn.errSelfWarn: Hierarchy Restriction: You cannot issue a warning or penalty to yourself!
adminWarn.errEqualOrHigherRole: Hierarchy Restriction: You cannot penalize a member who holds an equal or higher role than yours!
adminWarn.errVerbalReason: A valid reason is required when issuing a verbal warning.
adminWarn.errSelectRule: You must select a rule code (M1-M13, D1-D3, Y1-Y5) when issuing an official warning.
adminWarn.errInvalidEvidenceUrl: The evidence image URL must start with http:// or https://.

notRegistered.heading: You Must Register First
notRegistered.inGuildDesc: You are in our Discord server, but you do not yet hold the Verified Member role. To access member panels (My Profile, Tryout, Emergency Backup), please submit a registration application with your Roblox account.
notRegistered.notInGuildDesc: The Discord account you signed in with was not found in the Piyade Team | TSB Discord server. Please join our server first and then complete your registration application.
notRegistered.footerNote: Once your registration application is approved by staff, your roles and access permissions on this site will activate automatically.

errors.500DefaultMsg: The server encountered an issue while processing your request.
errors.errorCodeHint: Search this 8-character code in Railway > Deployments > Logs to see the exact cause of the error.
errors.botOfflineDesc: The Piyade Team website is a thin frontend. Member data, registration applications, and disciplinary logic reside on the Discord bot's REST API, which is currently unreachable.
errors.botOfflineStep1: The Discord bot or its REST API service on Railway may still be starting up or restarting.
errors.botOfflineStep2: The site's BOT_API_URL address may be misconfigured or the port is unreachable.
errors.botOfflineStep3: Ensure that the API_SECRET environment variable is identical on both services.
errors.oauthStateMismatch: Security verification failed (OAuth2 state parameter mismatch or expired). Please try signing in again.
errors.sessionRevokedNotInGuild: Your session has been terminated for security because you left the Discord server or your roles were removed.
errors.sessionRevokedNoPermission: Your management permissions have been revoked. Your session has been terminated.
errors.duplicateSubmission: This form has already been submitted (Duplicate submission prevented). Please refresh the page.
errors.emptyFile: An empty or invalid file was uploaded.
errors.fileTooLarge: Evidence image size cannot exceed 5 MB.
errors.svgNotAllowed: SVG files are not permitted for security reasons. Please upload PNG, JPG, or WEBP only.
errors.invalidFileType: Invalid file format (magic-byte check failed). Only genuine PNG, JPG, or WEBP images are allowed.
